about_the_game:
Next Player is a first-person psychological horror experience that begins on the dark screen of a forgotten console… and slowly seeps into your walls.

It started as just a game.
Now it knows you.

A journey begins with flickering lights on a static-filled screen. But then, something changes.
The game starts to respond — learning your movements, your decisions… your fears.

What you see is no longer just a screen.
It’s a threshold.

The audio glitches. The image distorts.
And yet, your fingers remain locked on the joystick.

You think you're playing a game.
But the truth is:

You're just the next player.
The door has opened.
And it's getting closer.

Features:

  • Indie Vision: A unique horror experience passionately crafted as the debut project of a solo developer.

  • Claustrophobic Nightmare: A single room that warps, decays, and collapses around you.

  • Reality Breach: A mind-bending “game within a game” that blurs the line between virtual and real.

  • Short But Devastating: 30 minutes of concentrated psychological dread.

  • Analog Horror: A nostalgic nightmare drenched in VHS static, CRT flickers, and corrupted visuals.

Put on your headphones. Turn off the lights. And most importantly - lock your door. Because now… it’s on your side.

Warning!

This game contains flashing lights, sudden loud noises, and visual distortion that may trigger photosensitive epilepsy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Next Player is a first-person psychological horror experience that begins as a game-within-a-game, then shatters your perception of reality. At first, it seems like an innocent game... until something changes. The door has opened. And now it's in your room.
